controls.title: Security of information systems of sensitive infrastructures
controls.summary: Operators of vital and sensitive infrastructures must implement security measures to protect their information systems, including access control, encryption, and monitoring. Publicly exposed cloud resources holding sensitive data fall under this obligation.

controls.title: Protection and confidentiality of data
controls.summary: Entities must protect the confidentiality and integrity of the data they process, notably through encryption of stored and transmitted data. Unencrypted storage of personal or sensitive data is a violation with potential penalties.

controls.title: Incident notification
controls.summary: Significant security incidents affecting information systems must be notified to the national authority (DGSSI) within the prescribed timeframe. Absence of logging and monitoring undermines the ability to detect and report such incidents.

controls.title: Access control and authorization
controls.summary: Access to sensitive information systems must be restricted to authorized persons following least privilege. Over-permissive cloud IAM roles that grant broad access violate this requirement.
